consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in annotation for controlling native sidecar injection per pod. Pods without it keep following the global ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS setting.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds a pod annotation, sidecar.istio.io/native-side. Setting it to true or false turns native sidecar injection on or off for that pod, and it overrides the global ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS environment variable.
